svg.title: A failed log, folded by the lines that repeat
svg.desc: Left: a job log with four set-up lines and 300 error lines that differ only in the file, the line number and the name. Right: the context keeps the lines around an error, compares them with paths and numbers blanked, shows a repeated line twice and counts the rest: 298 more lines like the two above. Jobs whose failing lines mostly match are printed once with the names of the jobs that share the failure, and are never merged by name.
svg.text: A failed log, folded by the lines that repeat
THE LOG, AS THE JOB WROTE IT
One problem in 300 files prints 300 lines.
Lines around an error. A repeat is shown twice, then counted.
Lines are compared with paths and numbers blanked:
[... 298 more lines like the two above ...]
The two lines before an error stay, as context.
Jobs are compared the same way. When most failing lines of two jobs match,
Jobs are never merged by name: a matrix runs several jobs under one name.
